# CrossTaskNeuralRepresentation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A shared latent representation of brain activity that captures commonalities across multiple cognitive tasks, learned via multi-source transfer learning. Enables iNEST architectures to reuse computational motifs across tasks, reducing energy consumption and improving real-time adaptability.
